name: Small Health Potion
description: A deep red potion with the familiar herbal smell every adventurer knows.

name: Large Health Potion
description: A more concentrated version, bottled thick to survive being jostled in a travel pack.

name: Small Mana Potion
description: A shimmering blue liquid, cool to the tongue.

name: Large Mana Potion
description: Kept in a crystal flask, used to recharge magic after the most exhausting spells.

name: Exploration Kit
description: Rope, chalk, and a well-worn map case — everything needed to press on a little longer between real rests.

name: Calming Draught
description: A strong herbal tea that slows the heartbeat amid the suffocating dark.

name: Antidote
description: A bitter white pill, trusted by dungeon healers.

name: Whetstone
description: A handheld sharpening stone — a few strokes are enough to make a blade sharp again.

name: Temporary Ward
description: A temporary charm, hastily carved on a piece of wood to soften the next blow.

name: Cracker String
description: A string of paper-wrapped charges, each the size of a thumb. Pull the end and they go off in order.

name: Pitch Bomb
description: Pitch and lamp oil in a fired jar, fuse of twisted rag.

name: Frost Flask
description: A flask of brine frozen solid, white with frost on the outside. It does not thaw in the hand.

name: Thunder Charge
description: A copper tube sealed at both ends with wax, heavy for its size. It hums when nothing is touching it.

name: Blister Bomb
description: Quicklime and sulphur packed into a clay shell that is thin on purpose.

name: Rot Bomb
description: Matter scraped from the bottom of a grave pit and sealed in clay before it had finished rotting.

name: Honing Oil
description: A flask of thin oil that smells of hot iron. The smell stays on the cloth for days.

name: Marrow Broth
description: A flask of marrow boiled down until it sets cold. Warmed in the hands, it pours.

name: Serpent Oil
description: Thick yellow-green oil drawn from something that bit. A blade wiped with it stays wet for the length of a fight.

name: Tar Flask
description: Black tar in a clay flask, thick enough to hold a thumbprint.

name: Smoke Pellet
description: A pinch of powder that goes to grey smoke when crushed.

name: Bandage Roll
description: Boiled linen, rolled tight and still stiff. It has been boiled more than once.

name: Resin Wrap
description: Pine resin over cloth, wound tight around the forearm.

name: Repelling Smoke Powder
description: A pinch of grey powder in a twist of paper. Burned at someone's feet, it gives off a sour smoke that nothing hunting wants to walk into.

name: Acid Vial
description: Green-stained glass, stoppered with wax, the inside of the glass etched cloudy.

name: War Paint
description: Ochre and ash, kept in a tin lid and thumbed across the cheek before a fight.

name: Fracture Charge
description: A shaped charge in a brass cup, made to be set against a plate.

name: Deafening Charge
description: A charge packed for noise and not fire, wrapped in wet leather so it does not go off in the pack.

name: Rally Standard
description: A torn banner on a broken haft, the colours faded to the same brown as everything else.

name: Bulwark Draught
description: Iron filings in wine. The skin goes grey and holds.

name: Field Tonic
description: A stoneware bottle meant to be split four ways, with four notches cut in the neck to show where.

name: Spark Salt
description: Coarse grey salt that crackles faintly when held near a mage's hand.

name: Scholar's Candle
description: A candle stub scored with fine lines at even intervals. Lit, it gives a steady light that does not move in a draught.

name: Hushed Bell
description: A small brass bell with the clapper bound in felt. Shaken, it makes no sound, and the room goes quiet around it.

name: Etched Lens
description: A disc of ground glass with a ring etched into one face. Held up, it makes edges look sharper than they are.

name: Pitch Pipe
description: A short reed pipe that gives one note and no other. Blown once in a room, everyone in it begins to hum the same pitch.

name: Burn Salve
description: A tin of grease and crushed aloe gone grey. It stings going on, and then it does not.

name: Styptic Powder
description: Alum ground fine and kept dry in waxed paper. Packed into a cut, it closes the edges.

name: Eyewash
description: A small bottle of boiled fennel and salt water, with a dropper made from a quill.

name: Thread Knife
description: A curved blade no longer than a finger, made for cutting thread. Webbing parts along its edge like wet paper.

name: Lye Wash
description: Thinned lye in a stoppered flask, for washing off what eats metal. It is rough on the hands.

name: Smelling Salts
description: Pale crystals in a brass case. One sniff and the eyes water, and whoever was down gets up.

name: Mending Paste
description: Tallow and clay worked into a grey paste. Smeared on armour, it fills the pits and stays.

name: Purge Draught
description: A cloudy draught that tastes of ash and river water. Whoever drinks it is sick within the minute, and better after.

name: Greater Health Potion
description: A dark red draught so thick it moves slowly when the bottle is tilted. It smells of iron before it smells of herbs.

name: Greater Mana Potion
description: A blue so deep it is nearly black in the flask. The glass is cold to hold.

name: Vermin Hide
description: Strips of hide peeled from the small things that live under the floors. Some of it is fur, some of it is skin, and it has all dried to the same grey.

name: Predator Sinew
description: A length of sinew as long as a forearm, still pulled tight by whatever it was cut from. It will not lie flat on any surface.

name: Chitin Shard
description: A curved shard of scale or plate; it is hard to say which. One edge is a seam that came apart clean, the other was broken off.

name: Cult Rag
description: A strip of coarse robe cloth, dyed a dark red-brown that may not be the original colour. The hem has been cut off all the way round.

name: Grave Cloth
description: Burial linen, brown at the folds and stiff where it was wet. It has been wrapped round something and unwrapped since, and the creases have not given.

name: Old Bone
description: A short bone polished on two faces where it slid against the next one. The third face is still rough.

name: Ooze Residue
description: Dried ooze, cracked into flakes like river mud. Something small is still set into one of them, too small to name.

name: Warband Trophy
description: A cord hung with teeth, a brass ring and a few small bones, knotted by someone who wanted them counted. It hangs heavier at one end.

name: Elemental Core
description: A fist-sized stone that is a different temperature every time it is picked up. Wherever it is set down it leaves a ring, damp or scorched, never the same twice.

name: Wraith Essence
description: A vial that looks empty. The inside of the stopper is cold, and stays cold.

name: Stone Core
description: A rough grey lump with one flat face, cut level by something that does not draw a straight line by eye. Tapped, it answers a little late.

name: Bat Blood
description: A stoppered vial of dark, thin blood that took several bats to fill. It smells of copper.

name: Bear Claw
description: A claw as long as a hand, blunted at the tip from years of being dragged along stone. Three grooves run down the flat side, deep as a thumbnail.

name: Silk Gland
description: A dried sac no bigger than a thumbnail, one end still trailing a fine thread. Pulled gently, it comes out a hand's length and stops.

name: Prayer Beads
description: A short string of dark beads, worn shiny along about a dozen and left rough elsewhere. Someone always held it in the same place.

name: Rotten Bandage
description: A bandage still wound in its last shape, stiff with something brown. The knot is neat.

name: Bone Shield Fragment
description: A curved slice of bone from a rim. Two small holes run through the inside, worn oval by the strap that used to pass through them.

name: Slime Solution
description: A jar of translucent ooze that has settled clear at the top. Whatever the slime had not finished dissolving is still in the jar.

name: Knuckle Guard
description: A bar of iron bent to fit a fist, the finger hollows worn deeper on one side. The hand it was made for was larger than yours.

name: Ember
description: A lump of charcoal that kept the grain of the wood it came from, and the knot where a branch left it.

name: Hollow Plate
description: A shoulder plate, rusted through on the inside and bright on the outside.

name: Core Fragment
description: A chip of dressed stone with one groove across it, ruled as straight as any mason could. The groove goes on past the edge, where the rest of the stone was.

name: Venom Thorn
description: A thorn as thick as a finger, the tip stained yellow-green. The stain is wet.

name: Warped Vambrace
description: A forearm guard bent inward along one side, as though what wore it swelled. The buckles are fastened and the leather is whole. It was never taken off.

name: Broken Oath Sigil
description: A badge cut in half through a device that can no longer be read. The cut is clean, and its edges are worn as smooth as the face.

name: Warlord's Trophy Chain
description: A length of chain hung with pieces of other people's armour: a buckle, a hinge, a spur, part of a rank badge. Each link was forged for weight.

name: Noble's Signet
description: A gold signet ring, the crest worn nearly flat from years of pressing into wax. It is always clean when the pouch is opened.

name: Dragon Scale
description: A scale as wide as a shield, still warm, with a metallic sheen. The edges are rounded from a lifetime of sliding against the others.

name: Unraveled Fragment
description: A thumb of grey matter with a hinge at one end and a row of small teeth at the other. Set on a table, the hinge closes slowly on nothing.

name: Weathered Keystone
description: A wedge of stone that once locked an arch in place. The curve of the arch is still cut into both faces, though nothing has curved above it for a long time.

name: Phylactery Shard
description: A curved sliver of black glass, thin as a fingernail. Held to the light, it shows the room with the door still shut.

name: Grave Dust
description: Bone ground to a fine grey dust and folded into a scrap of cloth. It clings to the fingers and takes more than one washing to leave.

name: Rotten Flesh
description: A palm-sized piece of flesh gone soft and dark, wrapped in a leaf that has stopped helping.

name: Broken Blade Fragment
description: A length of broken blade, snapped clean across with the edge still keen. The maker's mark is on the part that is missing.

name: Rat Tail
description: A rat's tail dried hard as cord, still curled the way it dried.

name: Venom Gland
description: A venom gland the size of a bean, taut as a grape and yellow at the stalk.
